analyses.question: How have Ghana mobile internet subscription counts and market shares changed over 31 months?
analyses.approach: Monthly shares, relative count growth, share percentage-point changes, net-growth contribution, alternative date windows, and anomalies
analyses.finding: MTN added 5,673,061 subscriptions Jan 2024–Jul 2026 while share fell 81.61% to 80.02%; Telecel share gained 2.92pp; AT lost 1.33pp.
analyses.status: Full 93-row NCA source-table audit passed; human peer review and publication approval pending
analyses.peer_check: 93/93 values and 31/31 mobile totals matched NCA primary PDF tables (AI-assisted verification; external human sign-off pending)
analyses.repro_notes: Read v2 report; replay tools/verify_gilb002_nca_v2.py; inspect 93-row source comparison ledger; preserve original NCA PDFs
analyses.limitations: Counts are subscriptions, not people; market share changes over time are not necessarily monotonic; monthly shifts have no verified causal explanation; NCA PDF binaries still need archiving.

evidence.claim: MTN held 80.02% of active mobile network data subscriptions in July 2026 (not of unique people)
evidence.verification_status: Source counts verified (AI-assisted 93-row NCA audit); human publication approval pending
evidence.qualification: 80.02% of active MNO mobile internet subscriptions in July 2026; not people, revenues, traffic, or all internet subscriptions

evidence.claim: GILB002-SHARE-TREND — Jan 2024–Jul 2026 MTN share fell 1.60pp; Telecel rose 2.92pp; AT fell 1.33pp
evidence.qualification: End-to-end comparison only; MTN share rebounded from mid-2025 low.

evidence.claim: GILB002-SUBSCRIPTION-GROWTH — Total MNO subscriptions grew 7,553,079 (+32.49%) between Jan 2024 and Jul 2026
evidence.qualification: Net active subscriptions, not newly acquired people or unique customers.

evidence.claim: GILB002-WINDOW-SENSITIVITY — MTN contributed 84.6% of net growth Dec25–Jul26, versus 75.1% Jan24–Jul26
evidence.qualification: Denominator is net stock change; operator negative change means contributions can exceed 100% before offsets.
